Liposarcoma ben differenziato (tumore li: Well-differentiated liposarcoma (atypical lipomatous tumor) of the quadriceps
Uomo di 51 anni. Tumefazione indolente d: 51-year-old man. Painless swelling of the right thigh, slowly increasing in size. Thigh MRI (available sequences: axial T1 and fat-suppressed T2; no contrast).
Referta in ordine: caratteristiche della: Report in order: characteristics of the mass, conclusion.
Una massa adiposa profonda non è automat:
A deep fatty mass is not automatically a lipoma. Signs suggesting an atypical lipomatous tumor / well-differentiated liposarcoma: size over 10 cm, deep location, thick (over 2 mm) or nodular septa, non-fatty areas, fat component below 75% of the mass, older age.
In this case the mass occupies much of the anterior compartment of the thigh; proximally it is almost entirely fatty with septa, distally there are non-fatty nodules that are hyperintense on T2: these are the areas to biopsy, because a nodular non-fatty component may also correspond to dedifferentiation (dedifferentiated liposarcoma, more aggressive).
In the limbs the lesion is called "atypical lipomatous tumor": it recurs locally but does not metastasize unless it dedifferentiates; histologic confirmation is obtained by testing for MDM2 amplification (FISH).
Technical note: in the proximal slices fat suppression is inhomogeneous (large field of view, bulky thigh): a suppression defect can mimic non-fatty tissue; comparison with T1 avoids the error.
Massa adiposa profonda, grande, con sett: Large deep fatty mass with thick septa or non-fatty nodules: atypical lipomatous tumor until proven otherwise; biopsy the nodules.
Liposarcoma ben differenziato, basso gra: Well-differentiated liposarcoma, low grade (clinical data from the Soft-tissue-Sarcoma collection). Treated with radiotherapy and surgery; disease-free at last follow-up (about 2.5 years).
Nodulo non adiposo nella porzione distal: Non-fatty nodule in the distal portion
